family.tagline: A plant nursery, a web shop and one Companion Core.
family.story: Thandi grows and sells plants from the greenhouse. Sipho, a backend engineer, builds the small web shop that takes the orders. One Companion Core in the Library keeps the shop’s code, its books and the plant journal.

companion.name: Fern
companion.job: Fills in courier and supplier web forms from Thandi’s notes.
companion.limits: Prepares only. Thandi checks each form and sends it herself.

companion.name: Acorn
companion.job: Opens courier tracking pages and lists the late parcels for Sipho.
companion.limits: Lists only. Sipho reads each list and writes any email himself.

popup.title: Sipho carries the parcel in
popup.body: A parcel waits on the front step. Sipho carries it to the Library, where Thandi has cleared the desk.

popup.title: Thandi lifts the Core out
popup.body: Thandi lifts the Companion Core onto the desk. Sipho finds a power cable, a quick-start guide and a recovery USB drive.

popup.title: Plug it in
popup.body: The cable goes in beside the monitor. Thandi presses the button, and the Core wakes and opens its own Wi-Fi network.

popup.title: Join it from a phone
popup.body: On her phone, Thandi opens the Wi-Fi settings and joins the Core’s own network. Then she chooses the home network.

popup.title: Pick the first agent and apps
popup.body: In the Companion Hub store, Thandi picks OpenClaw as the first agent. Sipho adds Gitea and HortusFox, and then they walk away.

beats.capability: an agent with its own browser, running in its own sandbox

popup.title: Fern says hello
popup.body: At the Library desk, Thandi types a first hello to the agent she named Fern. Fern answers from the Core beside her.

say.speaker: thandi
say.text: Hello, Thandi. I am Fern. Where shall we begin?

beats.capability: host private Git repositories, pull requests and issues on your Core

popup.title: Sipho pushes the postcode fix
popup.body: A buyer’s postcode keeps failing, so Sipho pushes a fix to Gitea. The code and its history sit on the Core, not on a rented code host.

beats.capability: host private Git repositories, pull requests and issues on your Core

popup.title: Thandi’s request becomes an issue
popup.body: From a club chair, Thandi asks for pot sizes on the plant pages. Sipho types it up as a Gitea issue, so the request sits beside the code.

beats.capability: an agent with its own browser, running in its own sandbox

popup.title: Acorn finds the late parcels
popup.body: Before packing starts, Sipho asks Acorn to open the courier’s tracking pages. Acorn lists the late parcels, and Sipho decides who gets an email.
popup.note: OpenClaw reaches websites over your home internet.

say.speaker: sipho
say.text: Here are the late parcels. Please read the list before you write.

beats.capability: keep customers, deals and custom fields in a CRM you host yourself

popup.title: Sipho copies each buyer into Twenty
popup.body: When a new order lands, Sipho’s script adds the buyer to Twenty. Thandi finds an address there before a delivery, and the customer list is hosted at home.

beats.capability: track your plants, watering and care history across rooms and beds, with photos and a garden journal

popup.title: Thandi repots the jade plant
popup.body: Among the birds of paradise, Thandi repots a jade plant and saves its photo and date in HortusFox. The care history lives on the Core.

beats.capability: keep customers, deals and custom fields in a CRM you host yourself

popup.title: Sipho logs Thandi’s promise
popup.body: Soil on her hands, Thandi tells Sipho what to promise a garden centre. He adds it to the garden centre’s row in Twenty, beside last spring’s order on the Core.

beats.capability: control and automate your smart home from one place, locally

popup.title: The lamps come on before Thandi
popup.body: On autumn mornings the two pendant lamps switch on just before Thandi opens up. Home Assistant runs the routine from the Core, with no cloud account.

beats.capability: an agent with its own browser, running in its own sandbox

popup.title: Fern readies the courier booking
popup.body: At the console table, Thandi wraps aloes for Monday’s wholesale order. Fern fills in the courier’s booking form, and Thandi checks the slot and sends it herself.
popup.note: OpenClaw reaches websites over your home internet.

say.speaker: thandi
say.text: Here is the booking, filled in. Please check the slot first.

beats.capability: a family planner with a shared calendar, tasks, shopping, meals

popup.title: Thandi and Sipho split market jobs
popup.body: On the sectional, Thandi and Sipho split Saturday’s market jobs. Crates and labels go to Thandi, the stall table to Sipho, and Yuvomi keeps one task board.

beats.capability: stream your own movies, shows and music to every screen in the house

popup.title: The time-lapse plays again
popup.body: The time-lapse of the greenhouse going up plays on the TV, and Thandi and Sipho watch it together. Jellyfin plays their own video files from the Core.

beats.capability: invoicing, expenses, customers and profit and loss for a small business

popup.title: Thandi raises a garden centre invoice
popup.body: After Saturday’s market, Thandi raises the garden centre’s invoice in Akaunting. Takings, invoices and customers share one set of books at home, on the Core.

beats.capability: back up, search and organise your family photos and videos on your own Core

popup.title: Sipho picks the lead pictures
popup.body: At the dining table, Sipho picks a lead picture for each plant page. Thandi’s plant photos back up to Immich, so the originals stay in a library at home.

beats.capability: a family planner with a shared calendar, tasks, shopping, meals

popup.title: Thursday’s lunch starts with chives
popup.body: Chives from the greenhouse sit on the breakfast bar, and Sipho plans Thursday’s lunch around them in Yuvomi. He adds the rest to the shared list on the Core.

beats.capability: send a push notification to your phone from any script or automation

popup.title: A new order pings Thandi’s phone
popup.body: While a pot simmers, Thandi’s phone buzzes once. A script Sipho runs posts each new web order to ntfy on the Core, which sends the push notification.

beats.capability: track your plants, watering and care history across rooms and beds, with photos and a garden journal

popup.title: Thandi cuts back the lavender
popup.body: Beside the lap pool, Thandi cuts back the lavender. She adds a note to its HortusFox page about how hard she cut, so next autumn the note is there.

beats.capability: ask a model that runs on your Core, from the browser

popup.title: Sipho asks a model about stock
popup.body: On the loungers, Sipho chases a drifting stock count in a JupyterLab notebook. He asks a model on the Core through Open WebUI, and the question stays there by default.

popup.title: A greenhouse, a shop, one Core
popup.body: One Companion Core in the Library, beside the greenhouse, keeps the plant journal, code, books and customer list.

closing.body: Your customer list, invoices and plant notes can live on a Companion Core at home. Browse the Companion Hub store and pick your first apps.

notes: The Library has no desk item in the spec (the only desk role is a kids desk upstairs); the Core stands on the hero desk, so Sipho's desk beats anchor on core and room:office.
The Greenhouse has no role furniture: its beats anchor on room:living nth 2 (Living & Dining and the Library come first, bigger rooms first).
Both companions are OpenClaw (browser errands). Neither has Companion Memory connected, so no beat names it.
No beat claims the web shop runs on the Core: Sipho's script copies buyers into Twenty and posts new orders to ntfy; no beat says how the shop reaches the Core or that the ping stays local.
Home Assistant: the two pendant lamps stand for network lights; no Zigbee or Bluetooth stick is implied.
